summary.text: Arienne Childrey is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 84 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Angela King.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Childrey said she served on the St. Marys City Council for the 4th Ward and described herself as a community advocate focused on affordable living, public safety and equality.

paragraphs.text: Arienne Childrey was born in Richlands, Virginia, and her career experience includes working in retail.
She has been affiliated with Northwest Ohio Trans Advocacy, an organization she said in her Ballotpedia survey she formed.
In the survey, Childrey said she became the first openly transgender person elected to any city council in Ohio.
Childrey ran for the same Ohio House seat in 2024, when Angela King defeated her in the general election.
In her 2026 survey she said she is the wife of a union laborer and is committed to good-paying jobs, affordable housing and healthcare, and rural economic opportunity.
She also said she supports raising teacher salaries, repealing the EdChoice voucher program and passing the Ohio Fairness Act.
